review_cost.rationale: One real round of changes: error recovery, enforced typechecking, and a handful of consistency cleanups. No architectural rework is needed, but it isn't an approve-with-nits either.

findings.issue: Memoized module-level promises cache rejections permanently, and there is no ErrorBoundary anywhere in app/src, so one transient API failure leaves a blank fallback page for the whole session
findings.suggestion: Reset the cached promise on rejection (e.g. wrap with a .catch that clears the memo) and add an ErrorBoundary with a retry in app.tsx around props.children

findings.issue: The entire data layer is typed `any` (species, pokemon, type, move details) under a strict tsconfig that nothing enforces — `npm run build` never runs tsc
findings.suggestion: Define interfaces for the API payloads (at least the top level of each resource) and add a `typecheck` script wired into build or CI

findings.issue: The search debounce timer isn't cleared when other params change; clicking Next page (which keeps Home mounted) within the 200 ms window lets the pending setParams reset page to 1
findings.suggestion: Clear the pending timer in onTypeChange/onGenerationChange and in the pagination handlers, or key the debounce on the whole query string

findings.issue: Lists rendered with `.map()` and `data()!` non-null assertions instead of `<For>`, inconsistent with every other route file
findings.suggestion: Use `<For each={pageItems()}>` and a non-asserted accessor inside the Show, matching moves/abilities/types routes

findings.issue: The `speciesById` map construction is duplicated verbatim in getHomeData, getMovePage, getAbilityPage and getTypePage
findings.suggestion: Export a `getSpeciesById()` helper next to getSpeciesIndex() and reuse it

findings.issue: Hand-rolled TTL cache + inflight dedup reimplements the dedup/caching that @solidjs/router's `query()` provides, adding a second caching layer on top of data.ts's memoized promises
findings.suggestion: Consider the router's `query` + `createAsync` (and route `preload`) so the framework owns dedup; at minimum document why the custom layer exists

findings.issue: Side effect in a component body setting documentElement.lang, redundant with `lang="en"` in entry-server.tsx's document shell
findings.suggestion: Rely on the entry document; if SPA mode bypasses entry-server, handle it there rather than in a render body

findings.issue: Comma-operator dedup idiom `!seen.has(id) && (seen.add(id), true)` is clever but hard to scan
findings.suggestion: Use an explicit filter callback with a Set check on its own line, as done in getTypePage (data.ts:355-362)

findings.issue: Header sorting is wired twice: onClick on the th plus a button with stopPropagation inside it
findings.suggestion: Keep only the button (better a11y semantics anyway) and drop the th onClick

findings.issue: Cache entries are never evicted — the TTL is only checked on read — so the Map grows with every distinct resource requested
findings.suggestion: Fine at this dataset size, but either bound the Map or delete expired entries on read; add a comment stating the expected bound

summary: A genuinely current, recognisably idiomatic SolidStart v2 app: config, routing, API routes and meta all match the docs, and the URL-as-state home page plus careful 404 handling show the author knew the framework. The merge blockers are in the data layer: a 430-line `any`-typed god module with hidden promise caches that poison the whole session on a single failed fetch, no error boundary, and no enforced typecheck. I'd want one solid round of changes — error recovery, typed payloads, and a few consistency cleanups — before merging.
